p1.bio: A hand on ore haulers for twenty years, and now the owner, on paper, of the ship she crews, which the bank owns most of. She keeps the books herself, in a notebook, and can tell you the cost of a watch to the credit.

c:ines.ambition: Wants a ship she does not have to ask permission to land.
c:ines.bio: She flew the Lisbon to Luna ferry for nine years, until the night she put a failing shuttle down on an unlit pad instead of ditching it as the tower ordered. Forty-one people walked off. She lost her license for the way she did it, and she kept the logbook.
memories: 9 Jun 2214: I told you about the landing, and you did not look at me differently.
13 Jun 2214: You vouched for me to a patrol.
14 Jul 2214: You stood by the cutoff while I flew it dead.
14 Jul 2214: We kept Tranquility Night aboard the Silver Ember.

c:tomas.ambition: Wants one ship kept running properly for ten years, with the same crew on her at the end of it.
c:tomas.bio: A dockyard welder who has rebuilt the same hull three times for three owners who each sold her out from under him. He sends most of his wages to a sister on Lagos Ring, and talks to every machine he works on.
memories: 9 Jun 2214: You helped me with the service on my own time.

c:cato.ambition: Wants a share of a ship, someday, so the crew he came up with could work one deck again.
c:cato.bio: He came up through the hold, and he knows every crew member by name and by family. He keeps the watch bill, and covers for the crew where the captain's rules would not.
memories: 13 Jun 2214: You told me what you needed, and I put it on the bill.

Insurance rates around Mars have doubled after a run of raids, and some captains are refusing the lane.
The Dome Concord and the Charter League trade accusations after a patrol standoff near Ceres.
A string of pirate attacks near Hygiea has haulers taking the long way round.
Customs on Enceladus seized a shipment of Refined Metals. Buyers there are desperate. (Saturn)
A warehouse on Europa has been cleared out in a hurry, and the Water is going, quite literally, for whatever anyone will pay. (Jupiter)
A survey ship of the Charter League is turned away from Earth by Arcology Compact patrols. Both sides release very different accounts.
Dockworkers on Juno Commons have gone on strike. Medical Supplies is suddenly scarce there. (Juno)
Word is that the governor of Triton Outpost is stockpiling Refined Metals for a party, and will pay well over the odds. (Neptune)
A message for Ines at Earth: their old ferry chief Duarte has retired to a house with a garden and a view of the water.
